name: audit-logger
description: Append-only tamper-evident audit log with SHA-256 checksums per row. No UPDATE or DELETE from normal code paths.

tools.name: log_execution
tools.description: Append a completed execution record to the audit log.

tools.name: log_auto_reject
tools.description: Append an auto-rejection record citing the specific policy rule.

tools.name: log_human_decision
tools.description: Append a human approval/rejection decision to the audit log.

tools.name: list_operations
tools.description: List completed operations for the audit log UI, paginated.

tools.name: verify_checksum
tools.description: Verify the stored SHA-256 checksum matches the current row content for an operation.
